title: Smoked mackerel on toast with quick pickled plums

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain home fare, and crème fraîche, horseradish sauce and wholemeal bread are all acceptable cupboard and fridge items.

supermarket.reason: Smoked mackerel, watercress, plums and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco lines at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two bowls, a knife and a toaster or grill.

works.reason: One plum, about 60g of mackerel and a thick slice of toast each makes a sensible breakfast for four, and a 10-minute quick pickle of sliced plums works.

honest_times.reason: Twelve minutes covers slicing the plums, zesting, snipping chives, skinning the fish, toasting and assembling, and the 10 cook minutes match the pickling rest.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early-September plums get a whole plum per serving as a distinct pickled topping, which suits a late-summer morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, wholemeal toast, fruit and watercress make a filling breakfast of real food.
